headline: New malware uses AI models for attack decisions
summary: A new Windows malware called ClosedQuorum uses AI models including Google Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen and Mistral to autonomously choose post-compromise actions, reportedly the first documented Windows implant to use LLMs for command and control.

claims.statement: A new Windows malware called ClosedQuorum uses AI models to autonomously decide post-compromise actions.

sources.quote: A new Windows malware named ClosedQuorum uses Google Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen, and Mistral AI models to autonomously determine the actions to take during post-compromise stages of an attack.
Windows CLOSEDQUORUM malware uses AI models to autonomously select post-compromise actions

claims.statement: ClosedQuorum specifically uses Google Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen, and Mistral AI models.

sources.quote: uses Google Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen, and Mistral AI models

claims.statement: The Register calls it the first publicly documented Windows implant to use LLMs for command and control.
